name: codex-project-scoped-mcp
description: Automatically load the MCP tools declared in your current project's mcp.json.

interface.longDescription: Install once, then open a project in Codex. Local Project MCP finds the nearest mcp.json within that checkout, starts its local servers from the project directory, and connects any configured remote servers. The project's tools become available for that session, without a launch wrapper, watcher, or configuration sync. Requires Node.js 22+ and each server's own runtimes and credentials. Runs on your machine; it does not upload your project to a hosted bridge.
capabilities: Use local and remote project tools
